The 2026 Amazon Prime Day is officially on, with loads of new all-time lows on Apple gear. Today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by the official Prime Day AirPods deals with $150 off new AirPods Max 2, $70 off AirPods Pro 3, and more, alongside Prime Day Apple Watch deals from $199 – Series 11 and Ultra 3 at $150 off. We also have iPhone 17 Pro hitting new all-time lows with official Prime Day discounts at up to $365 off (Amazon Renewed Premium), the 2026 AirTag 2 hitting all-time low pricing, and a super rare discount on the official black Apple Magic Mouse. Head below for a closer look.

Amazon 2026 Prime Day sale now live! 4-days, millions of deals, all-time low prices

Official Prime Day AirPods deals now live: $150 off new AirPods Max 2, $70 off AirPods Pro 3, more

After loads of notable early deals, the 2026 Amazon Prime Day sale is now officially live with millions of price drops and the AirPods deals are now up for grabs. We are tracking price drops on all current-generation Apple AirPods including a giant $150 off AirPods Max 2 and AirPods Pro 3 at nearly 30% off the list price. Get a closer look and more details below.

Prime Day 2026 AirPods deals

Perhaps the most notable deal of the lot, or at least the most surprising, is AirPods Max 2 at a straight up $150 off the list. These things just released a few months ago now or so and catching anything better than $100 or maybe $120 off was not expected. There was always a chance Amazon got particularly aggressive here, and, thankfully, it very much did:

  • AirPods Max 2 from $399 (Reg. $549)

While we did catch a deal down at $10 less recently, we are still talking about solid $70 price drop on AirPods Pro 3 – arguably the best ANC earbuds you can buy. Now within $10 of the lowest price we have ever tracked, you can land set down at $179 shipped:

  • AirPods Pro 3 $179 (Reg. $249)

The AirPods 4 aren’t down at the wild prices we caught during Black Friday last year, but if you are looking to snag a set of Apple’s most affordable current-gen buds the base model is now down at $99 shipped for Prime Day 2026:

  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)

FEATURED: The best robotic cleaners hit the best prices of the year – roborock vacs and mops up to $1,500 off

The official roborock 2026 Prime Day deals are now live, delivering some of the best prices of the year on the most popular robotic cleaning solutions out there. You’re looking at some massive price drops here at up to $700 off the list prices on everything from its flagship, all-in-one Saros 10R Robot Vacuum and Mop at a new all-time low, through to far more affordable robotic models like the Q7 M5+ from $250, and even its F25 series upright wet/dry steam vacuum mops. All of this year’s best roborock Prime Day deals are waiting in its official Amazon store and we will leave you some highlights below:

  • roborock Saros 10R Robot Vacuum and Mop $900 (Reg. $1,600)
  • roborock Qrevo Curv 2 Flow Robot Vacuum and Mop $800 (Reg. $1,000)
  • roborock Qrevo S Pro Robot Vacuum and Mop$450 (Reg. $700)
  • roborock F25 Ultra Steam Wet Dry Vacuum Cleaner$475 (Reg. $800)
  • And even more…

iPhone 17 Pro hits all-time low with official Prime Day discounts at up to $365 off (Amazon Renewed Premium)

The 2026 Amazon Prime Day sale is now live and we are actually getting some official Amazon Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro deals this year. Unlike the refurbished units we have featured thus far, these are Amazon best quality renewed models at the lowest price we have tracked to date – we are talking up to $365 off the new list prices here.

Amazon Prime Day iPhone 17 Pro deals

  • Cosmic Orange iPhone 17 Pro 512GB $1,000 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • Deep Blue iPhone 17 Pro 512GB $1,061 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB $1,147 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 256GB $934 (Reg. $1,099 new)

As you can see above from the official Prime Day iPhone 17 Pro deals, the 512GB and 1TB configurations are seeing the most notable deals compared to the brand new unlocked prices from Apple. This is typically the case, but it is also the first time we have tracked particularly notable discount on Amazon Renewed Premium models with prices this low.

As we have detailed previously, the Amazon Renewed Premium units are easily some of the best ways to score a discount on current-generation, unlocked iPhone units. These things are basically never on sale brand new, and Amazon just about always undercuts the Apple refurb store significantly (Apple doesn’t yet sell iPhone 17 Pro for the record).

Super rare early Prime Day deal hits Apple’s latest black Magic Mouse (Lowest price in over a year)

Apple’s 2026 M5 MacBook Air lineup is now at $150 off for Prime Day

As part of the now live 2026 Prime Day sale, Amazon is now offering $150 cash discounts across the 2026 M5 MacBook Air lineup. While not every color is down this low right now, most of them are.

Prime Day M5 MacBook Air deals

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $949 (Reg. $1,099)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,149 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,149 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,549 (Reg. $1,699)

We were very much hoping to see these things back down at $200 off across the board for Prime Day, but as of the time of writing, as the sale officially goes live, we are looking at $150 price drops. All things considered, we are talking about a new 2026 MacBook release and right after Tim Cook threatened price hikes due to memory shortage and supply chain issues – this might be the best deals we see. We will, however, be keeping a close eye on the listings throughout the next 4-days.

Current-gen Apple Watch SE 3 drops back to best price ever, now just $199 ahead of Prime Day

Amazon is not playing around with the early Prime Day Apple Watch deals to start the week. The most popular Apple Watch Series 11 models are now down at new all-time low prices from $279, while Ultra 3 is now $150 off, but now the current-generation Apple Watch SE 3 has dropped back to its best price ever starting at $199 shipped.

Apple Watch SE 3 early Prime Day deals

As you can see above, the base GPS-only models have now dropped back to the best prices ever for the first time since Black Friday and the 2025 holiday season. In fact, today is the first time either of these two models have sold this low since then.

The 44mm cell model at $249 is certainly a notable price, but it is one we have seen a few times previously. All things considered, Apple’s SE 3 is delivering some serious bang for your buck on the base models here today, especially since receiving the must-have always-on display for the first time, gesture support, and with the same chip than runs the Series 10 at the heart of the operation.

Apple’s most affordable current-gen iPad just came back in stock down at $299 with Father’s Day delivery

After going completely out of stock over the last couple days, Amazon’s deal on Apple’s most affordable current-generation iPad has returned at $299 just in time for last minute Father’s Day gifting.

Amazon is now once again offering the 11-inch iPad A16 down at $299 shipped to match the best price of the year, and it is now live on all four colors.

Regularly $349, this base model went completely out of stock a couple days ago but has now made a return right before the delivery cut off for Father’s Day. As of the time of writing, Amazon’s listings for this model still say “arrives 2 days before Father’s Day.”

  • iPad 11 128GB $299 (Reg. $349)
  • iPad 11 256GB $399 (Reg. $449)
  • iPad 11 256GB $597 (Reg. $649)

All three storage tiers are marked down right now, but I think most folks zero-in on the most affordable of the lot with this model. It is, after all, the most casual tablet Apple sells and, unless Dad is a serious iPad power user, there’s some serious bang for your buck on the entry config. If you or Dad are just looking for a simple and casual iPad experience, this thing can make for a great low-cost solution that you can still have in time for Dad’s cookout this weekend.
